profile.org_note: Two Region Presidents (Sikorski: FL, NC, OH, 8 divisions; Jacobs: TX, TN, IL, MN, IN, MI, 9 divisions; 2026 proxy) supervise the Area Presidents who run the 17 divisions; these portfolios cut across the 10-K reporting segments (Northern, Southern). Each division has its own VP of Land and VP of Finance (current Indianapolis land postings, Sep-Oct 2026), whose underwriting files go up for executive-leadership approval through the corporate land acquisition committee (members not named); no corporate land head is published, so land deals are decided by the Area President and Region President with the CEO, CFO and committee, and treasury sits with VP Treasurer Mark Kirkendall.
profile.email_pattern: first initial(s) + last name @mihomes.com (e.g. mkirkendall@mihomes.com, amhunker@mihomes.com)
profile.summary: Columbus-based public builder (NYSE: MHO), 8,921 closings in the 2026 Builder 100 ranking, operating 17 divisions in OH, IN, IL, MN, MI, FL, NC, TX and TN with 246 communities at 2026-09-30. It controlled 48,934 lots at 2026-09-30 (23,425 owned, 25,509 under contract), targets a three-to-five-year supply and developed over 80% of its lots itself in 2025. Management says it does virtually no land banking and prefers on-balance-sheet control with contingent purchase contracts, so it is a hard target for a land banker; any conversation runs through the CFO, the Treasurer and the two Region Presidents.

gaps: Corporate head of land (chief land officer / EVP or SVP land / CIO): none publicly named in the 2026 proxy, FY2025 10-K, annual report or current job postings; land approvals run through an unnamed corporate land acquisition committee and 'Executive Leadership'.

Region names: not published; the company identifies the two regions only by the Region President and the divisions each oversees (2026 proxy). A search snippet showed 2026 Workable postings for 'Region Marketing Director' of a 'Florida and North Carolina Region', a 'Michigan and Ohio Region' and a 'Texas and Tennessee Region' (pages 404 when opened), which suggests a separate marketing grouping that does not match the Region President split; not used.
Region-level land or finance heads (regional VP of land / region CFO): not publicly disclosed; land and finance VPs sit at division level.
Corporate land acquisition committee members: not publicly disclosed.

Division VPs of Land: eight names appear only in third-party directory search snippets (rows tagged Inferred); none confirmed on a company or press page, and divisions are unknown for most. Three further snippet-only names (Robert Zoromski, Cody Simoneaux, Thomas Lofquist, each shown with a Vice President, Land title) were too thin to record as rows.
Regional vice president(s) of land: the role existed (Ed Suchora held it about 2016 to 2018); current holder(s) not found.
Kevin Hake (possible Senior Vice President, finance / business development): seen only on one unreliable aggregator snippet; not confirmed as current, so not recorded as a row.
Treasurer start date and background: not publicly disclosed.
Chief Operating Officer: none; the CEO also holds the President title.
Area Presidents: only Charlotte (2025 source) and Sarasota (2018 source) captured here; the other 15 divisions were not reached in this part (another agent is sweeping division presidents).
Reporting lines: not stated in filings; all reports_to values are inferred from titles and the 10-K description of Area Presidents supervised by Region Presidents.
Succession: CEO and CFO are both 73 and Region President Sikorski is 71; no successor is publicly named.

Land-team reporting lines: not confirmed. Job-posting snippets say land roles report 'to the VP of Land and the Area President', but the postings, the investor-site Officers & Directors page and directory sites (zoominfo, comparably, wiza) were not read.
